label: Guidance table: an outweighed reason raised alone guides good-tracking, not blind or fixed favouring
paraphrase: Analyst formulation on one finite carrier: two candidates c and d, two respects (fit, and extra content that fit does not record) with graded weights, and two scenarios. In base, d weighs 2 and c 1 in fit, c weighs 3 and d 0 in the extra respect, and c is better overall (sum 4 against 2); in raised only d's fit weight is raised (to 6), and d is better overall. At base, for the fit reason for d over c: (1) raised raises d in fit alone; (2) the good-tracking profile, which the personal source and the imitability-exemplar rival share, is guided by that outweighed reason (it favours d over c at raised); (3) a fit-blind profile that follows the extra respect alone meets the outweighed condition and is not guided; (4) a favouring fixed to c over d meets the outweighed condition and is not guided; (5) a nature following fit alone does not favour c over d at base, so for it the reason is not outweighed; (6) with favourings as their own determinations, the second-order standard ranks the good-tracking profile over the fit-blind one in every scenario. Which account a profile represents is an interpretive assignment; the test is profile-level, so it gives the personal source and the rival the same verdict. A finite structural surrogate; no apprehension or simplicity is typed.
